body:
Plugin Introduction:

GuiBindPro is a professional item binding and security management plugin designed for Minecraft servers. It aims to completely resolve ownership and circulation security issues for valuable items on servers. The plugin can lock item ownership through various methods such as automatic pickup, usage, binding shops, or binding stones. It also deeply intercepts listing attempts of bound items in popular shop plugins like QuickShop and GlobalMarket, preventing black-market trading of gear and items at the source.

The plugin allows separate configuration of usage, attack, and drop rules for "Bound" and "Pending Binding" states. It includes built-in mechanisms for automatic recovery of accidentally dropped bound items and retrieval via in-game currency or points. The binding mechanism supports both NBT and Lore data storage. You can choose either one or both methods to ensure data stability while achieving optimal display and compatibility. For data, it supports both SQLite and MySQL databases with scheduled backups. All interfaces and menus are highly customizable.

![介绍](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e59a720fe63e5806f91f9c9d6fcc6eb8e54980e1_0.webp)
Plugin Features:

1. Supports four automatic binding methods: After Obtain/After Equip/After Pickup/After Use
2. Supports item binding via a binding shop menu, with gold or point requirements
3. Supports binding stones: Move a binding stone onto an item in the inventory to bind it
4. Supports custom "Pending Binding" states, where items cannot be used until manually bound via Shift + Left-click
5. Supports customizable behavior rules for bound items (e.g., allow/disable use, attack, trade, drop for "Pending Binding" or "Bound" states)
6. Supports full customization of binding states, bound player names, and other metadata
7. Supports dual storage mechanisms: NBT and Lore
8. Supports unbinding via customizable menus, with unbinding stone levels matching item Lore levels
9. Supports bound item retrieval with real-time state synchronization (retrievable via gold or points)
10. All menus and functions are highly configurable via YAML files, covering 99% of use cases
11. Supports official servers: Auto-updates bound item info when players change their names
12. Supports customizable binding storage chests for safe recovery of items lost due to death, offline/full inventory, or accidental drops
13. Supports SQLite and MySQL databases with data conversion, export, import, and scheduled automatic backups
14. Compatible with popular shop plugins (QuickShop-Hikari, GlobalMarketPlus, AxAuctions, PlayerAuctions) to intercept bound item listings in real time
15. Supports "Lore Refresh": Automatically updates old bound Lore to new Lore when configuration changes
